about.lead: Timmerman Injectables is a small-scale clinic centred around one treating professional. That means attention, continuity and an unhurried conversation.

items.q: How long does botulinum toxin last?
items.a: The effect is temporary and varies with the person, area and dose. The Dutch Healthcare Inspectorate gives approximately twelve weeks as a general indication. Your doctor will discuss what is realistic for you. [Medical copy requires approval.]
In the Netherlands, cosmetic treatment without medical necessity is generally for people aged 18 and over. Discuss any uncertainty with the doctor.

disclaimer.intro: Draft version — all medical information and emergency instructions must be reviewed by the treating doctor before publication.

sections.title: No personal medical advice
paragraphs: The information on this website is general and does not replace a consultation, diagnosis or personal advice from an authorised and competent doctor. Suitability can only be assessed after a medical consultation.

sections.title: Risks and outcomes
paragraphs: Cosmetic injectables are medical procedures and are not risk-free. Effect, duration, recovery and potential side effects vary by person. Outcomes cannot be guaranteed.

sections.title: Age and consent
paragraphs: In the Netherlands, cosmetic treatment without medical necessity is generally intended for people aged 18 and over. Informed consent is required.

sections.title: Complaints and emergencies
paragraphs: After treatment, always follow your personal aftercare instructions and contact the clinic immediately via its aftercare number if unexpected symptoms occur. Call 112 in a life-threatening situation. This website is not an emergency service.
